name: docchat
description: Ask questions about your project's libraries at the exact versions your lockfile pins. Eval-measured: 88% accuracy, 94% version correctness, 100% refusal on out-of-scope.

commands.title: DocChat: Set up sidecar (install Python dependencies)

docchat.sidecarPython.description: Path to the Python interpreter used to run the sidecar. Default: 'python' on PATH. The 'DocChat: Set up sidecar' command writes the managed venv path here automatically.

docchat.sidecarPort.description: Port the sidecar should bind to. 0 = pick a random free port at startup.

docchat.chatModel.description: OpenAI chat model the agent uses. gpt-4o-mini is the cheap default; gpt-4o is slower but sharper.

docchat.scoreFloor.description: Cosine-similarity floor for SearchDocsTool. Hits below this score are dropped so the agent refuses cleanly rather than hallucinating off weak retrievals.

docchat.maxIterations.description: Hard cap on agent ReAct iterations per query.

docchat.selfCritique.description: If true, the agent runs a second LLM pass over its own draft answer to catch APIs not present in retrieved context. Adds ~2s + ~$0.0001 per query.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run prepackage && npm run compile
